baron1: Travelers, I have summoned you because my herald, Sir Baldric the architect of the truce, lies dead without any visible wound.
baron2: If the truth does not come to light some will think it was provoked, the truce will break and the border will burn.
baron3: I need neutral eyes. You answer neither to my enemies nor to my vassals.
menu_stakes: What is at stake if we fail?
menu_exit: Not yet. We need a moment.
baron4_whyus: My captains see enemies in every shadow; my clerics see guilt in every breath.
baron5_whyus: You are outside the dispute: paladin, witch, barber-surgeon, archer… neutral toward my houses and the neighboring realm.
baron6_whyus: I need a truth that cannot be dismissed as a political weapon.
baron7_stakes: If you do not solve this before dawn, the border lords will demand blood.
baron8_stakes: The peace agreement will fall; caravans and villages will pay for a senseless death.
baron9_stakes: And if you accuse without proof, the clock will rush toward dawn. I will not make that mistake again.
baron10_reward: If you bring a solid and presentable truth:
baron11_reward: 300 gold coins and a signed safe-conduct to travel through my lands.
baron12_reward: If you prevent war, I will add supplies for your company and a quarter load at the provision posts.
paladin1_accept: We accept. We will serve the truth.
baron13_accept: Good. The night begins now: Deep Night. Speak with whoever you need: kitchens, armory, chapel, map room, passageways.
baron131_accept: Here are some tablets with marks that will tell you everyone’s location, although the castle works have changed some things.
baron14_accept: You may move about the castle. Bring proof, not rumors.
paladin2_exit: One moment, my lord. We must organize our questions.
baron15_exit: Do not delay; the night will not wait.
cocinero1_intro: Investigation? Well, you arrive on the worst night to ask. The kitchen looks like a war market.
menu_cocinero_herald: Did the Herald pass through here?
cocinero2_context: Since the storm and amid the works, everything is upside down: tablets moved, blocked hallways, and me with twenty pots on the fire.
cocinero3_herald: The Herald passed through twice this week. His eyes were tired, as if seeking rest more than dinner.
cocinero4_wine: Expensive. He was keen on moon wine… yes.
cocinero6_exit: If you want answers, follow the crumbs… I return to my pots.
sacerdote1_intro: Investigation? May the light guide you, for with so much work people get confused and come to me asking for something to eat.
sacerdote2_intro: Here people should come to have their soul healed and their worldly body.
menu_sacerdote_incense: Have you been asked for any healings these last days, and for whom?
menu_sacerdote_deliveries: Do you deliver the orders yourself?
paladin3_runas: What do you mean when you mention the runes?
sacerdote3_runas: You should know they are what protect the castle from evil spells along with a wise dose of prayers.
sacerdote4_context: The chapel is silent but not at peace. The lamps flicker and the runes seem restless since the storm.
sacerdote5_incense: I delivered incense, to calm the spirit of a feverish man and another for joint pain. I did not ask who they were for.
sacerdote6_deliveries: No, the new maid takes care of deliveries.
sacerdote7_deliveries: She bore marked tablets to guide her through the castle parts like you and was somewhat lost.
sacerdote8_exit: May the truth be with you. I will return to my prayers.
sirvienta1_intro: Me? I’m just a simple maid and I go where I am ordered, my lord.
sirvienta2_context: Dark, twisted. The lamps light without warning.
sirvienta3_deliveries: They gave me two orders and two tablets. I followed the directions. I hope I did not err.
sirvienta4_novata: I’m new, my lord. I barely know anyone.
sirvienta5_done: If something did not arrive where it should, it was not for lack of will. The works confuse more than fatigue.
guardia1_intro: Investigation? Then you ask the wrong man if you seek calm. Tonight everything vibrates.
menu_guardia_turnos: How were the shifts after the storm?
guardia2_context: Dark and disturbed. Tools on the floor, tablets moved and runes flickering like fireflies.
guardia3_sello: There is a side seal that should be recalibrated, I think. But the castle’s mage is away for personal reasons.
guardia4_turnos: The storm upset everything. I doubled guard. We’re short staffed and those here are exhausted.
guardia6_exit: I only follow orders and await dawn.
archivero1_intro: Investigation? Then you seek words, not swords. Here all is scrolls and dust.
menu_archivero_context: How is the map room tonight?
menu_archivero_herald: Did the Herald leave any trace in his reports?
menu_archivero_requests: Did he ask for anything unusual lately?
archivero2_context: Silence and chaos at once. The works moved shelves and the lamps stay brightly lit for a good while.
archivero3_herald: His reports talk of tiredness. Crooked letters, long pauses… as if the ink weighed more than the quill.
archivero4_requests: Days ago he asked for notes on calming fumigations. He said they were for sleepless nights.
archivero5_exit: I only keep what others write.
